title: Kingdom Quest: Discovering My Divine Purpose
translation_note: Memory Gems quote the World English Bible (public domain), which renders the divine name as Yahweh.

day_rules.realm_of_day: min(52, ceil(day / 7)); realm 52 holds days 358-365, so day 365 is the Coronation celebration
day_rules.sabbath_camp: The 7th day of every realm (day % 7 == 0) is Sabbath Camp: a lighter review day that hosts the weekly Identity Milestone
